curation: A lemma is added only when comparing two REAL items required it. Never added speculatively, never auto-added by the search itself -- an auto-grown library reproduces exactly the false-IDENTICAL risk the hash recipe guards against. Retired entries are archived with the witness that retired them, never deleted.

lemmas.statement: For a polynomial F with a root of multiplicity exactly m at x0, F changes sign at x0 if and only if m is odd.
lemmas.proof_sketch: Locally F(x) = (x-x0)^m G(x) with G(x0) != 0; the sign near x0 is sign(G(x0)) times sign((x-x0)^m), which flips exactly when m is odd.
lemmas.why_it_matters: This is the lemma that lets SIGN_CHANGE be dropped as a bindable slot on ROOT_MULT. Without it, one fact could be written two ways and hash differently.

lemmas.statement: If h is strictly monotonic on its domain and h(a) = h(b), then a = b.
preconditions: h strictly monotonic on the domain in question
lemmas.why_it_matters: Collapses 2^v + v = k + log2(k) to v = log2(k), since h(t) = 2^t + t has h'(t) = 2^t ln2 + 1 > 0 everywhere.
